plainLanguage: Section 124A — Repealed. Ufafanuzi huu unasoma masharti ya kifungu kwa vipengele vyake bila kubadilisha official statutory text.
meaning: Kifungu 124A kimefutwa (repealed) na hakina substantive offence inayotumika kutoka kwenye maandishi haya.
keyPoints: The provision is expressly marked repealed.
Do not treat a repealed provision as creating a current offence.

history.summary: Section 124A appears in Chapter XIII — Miscellaneous Offences Against Public Authority — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Text verified against the official R.E. 2022 government publication.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The offence should be analysed from each express element rather than from the section heading.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Where lawful authority, wilfulness, knowledge, exceptions or alternative statutory penalties matter, they require separate consideration.

debateQuestion: Je, facts na evidence zinatimiza masharti yote ya section 124A?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
